text_block_list.text: Yay! Yes! Yes! I came in first, Trainer!

text_block_list.text:
Me! Shining brilliantly center stage in
the winning
concert!

text_block_list.text:

did you
think?

did you
think?

enough to

text_block_list.text:

wanna hear
all about how cute I am!

Well, well, well... Someone's getting a little full
of themselves!

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, took you long enough to notice!
I'm in a
fantastic mood! ☆

text_block_list.text:
I've gotta put on a big smile and enjoy
this
fabulous victory to the fullest...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: We can't get too comfortable... I agree!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm trying to become a top
Umadol who
doesn't lose to anyone!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I have to keep on winning forever and
ever so
that I never let go of center
stage!

choice_data_list: If anyone can do it, I know it's you!

text_block_list.text:

happy! ☆

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for believing in me. Now I
have to
work even harder. For you...

text_block_list.text:
Because today's gonna be an important
milestone
on my journey to becoming a
